subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Your Car Tracks You
description: One-minute skill: Your Car Tracks You.

hook.text: Modern cars collect more data than your phone. Speed, location, braking habits — even your weight.

buildup.text: Connected cars send driving data to manufacturers, insurers, and sometimes law enforcement.

discovery.text: GM was caught sharing detailed driving data with insurance companies without clear driver consent.

twist.text: You can't opt out of most car data collection. The sensors are built in and always active.

climax.text: Your car is a rolling surveillance device. It knows where you go, how fast, and who rides along.

punchline.text: You drive the car. The car reports on you.

quiz.question: What kind of data do modern connected cars collect?
options: Speed, location, braking habits, and even passenger weight
Data is only collected during crashes
